keyEvents.text: Goal! West Ham United 1, Derby County 0. Joël Piroe (West Ham United) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Valentín Castellanos with a headed pass.
Alex Mowatt (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Derby County. David Ozoh replaces Rhian Brewster because of an injury.
First Half ends, West Ham United 1, Derby County 0.
Second Half begins West Ham United 1, Derby County 0.
